title: André Aulich - Writing
subtitle: Articles and notes on data & AI strategy, enterprise architecture, domain-driven design, and broadcast IT.

posts.title: Thinking in Scenarios
posts.description: For decisions which change the rest of a plan, I like to prepare alternatives before anyone has decided, so that everyone can see the consequences of each option and the work can continue right after the decision. A garden party and an architecture project show how far to work out such an alternative and where preparing it doesn't help.

posts.title: Where Juniors Start When AI Does the Simple Work
posts.description: When AI takes over the simple tasks with which juniors used to learn their job, many wonder how a career should start today and why companies should hire juniors at all. Looking back at how my own career started with the internet in the 1990s, I explain why I think the same model works for AI and what companies can look for when they hire people at the start of their career.

posts.title: The Human Measure of AI
posts.description: We give an AI agent trust the way we give it to a new colleague, and we cut work for agents the way a company cuts its work into departments, so that each part fits into one head or one context window. This article looks at why we model AI on people and why I think this lets us keep AI under control, although some human limitations come along with it.
